name: Report download logs and floor-plan progress PDFs
summary: Who downloaded which report and when, and downloading a floor plan with its progress markings as a PDF for selected categories and stages.

roles.note: The reporting PRD leaves open which roles may see the logs.

actions.note: Access details for this item are handled with engineering separately.

nfr.statement: Largest floor-plan PDF (levels, categories, page size) that must generate successfully.
nfr.open_question: How large can a multi-level floor-plan PDF get before it must be split or emailed only?

requirements.title: Report downloads are logged and listed per report
requirements.statement: Each report download is logged with the project, the user, the report's type, ID and name, and the time. A report's log lists the project name, report name and type, the downloader's name and email, and the time. Downloads by support users are left out of the list for customers.
requirements.rationale: The reporting PRD also asks for a CSV export of the log named log_{report_name}_{YYYYMMDD}.csv; the service returns JSON only and no CSV export was found. The download is logged by the client calling the log route, so a download that skips that call is not logged.

requirements.title: Out-of-scope assets in a floor-plan PDF follow the viewer setting
requirements.statement: A floor-plan progress PDF is built from the viewer's current filters: if out-of-scope assets are hidden in the viewer they are left out of the PDF. The report-scheduling PRD says out-of-scope assets should appear in black in the downloaded file.

dispute.summary: report-scheduling.md EC-006 shows out-of-scope assets in black. The web app passes showOutOfScope=false to the report when they are hidden, which is the customer default (PROG-REQ-057).

requirements.title: Download a floor plan with progress markings as a PDF
requirements.statement: From the progress details page a user selects categories and stages, chooses page size, layout and format, and downloads a PDF whose colours match the platform; the PDF is also emailed to them. Download is not offered in compare mode. Takeoff and progress values are left out when the selected stages don't share a unit. Reports can cover several levels at once and be scheduled, appending pages without title pages.
requirements.rationale: PRD only as a whole. Recurring delivery itself is RPT-FEAT-03; the web app does build floor-plan report requests from the selected stages or categories (RPT-REQ-013). Formats other than PDF and the progress-delta view are out of scope in the PRD.
